emerging_technology: Sodium-ion battery systems for stationary storage
intended_application: Assess a pilot behind-the-meter storage system at a refrigerated distribution warehouse.
business_need: Manage peak demand and improve resilience to short interruptions.
users_stakeholders: Facility operators, fire authority, insurer, energy manager
capabilities_constraints: Assume the site has metering and room for a pilot; installation quotations, warranties and site safety review are unavailable.
risk_consequence_context: Thermal incidents, insufficient runtime or warranty exclusions could disrupt refrigerated goods and safety.
management_question: Would a 2027 pilot improve the whole-life value and risk profile versus lithium-ion storage?
additional_context: Hypothetical teaching case created 2026-11-16 for a prospective 2027 decision; organizational details and the proposed monitoring trigger are assumptions, not observations or forecasts. Conventional baseline: Lithium iron phosphate storage and conventional backup generation. Complement or dependency: Battery management, approved installation and fire protection. Proposed monitoring trigger and owner: Facilities lead reviews quotations and testing quarterly; reconsider if independent site-relevant lifetime cost, safety evidence and warranty terms meet pre-agreed requirements. Hype-sensitive assertion to test, not a fact: Sodium-ion is automatically cheaper and safer than every lithium-ion system.
